title: THE OUTFIT PREVIEWS FILL THEIR TILES
why: Seen on the FASHION screenshot of 2026-10-07, right after v18.79: the operator in each outfit tile filled only about half of the picture, small in a big tile. Each preview now measures its own figure and draws it big enough to stand nearly the full height of the tile, head to boots, whatever the outfit adds on top.
now: The operator in each FASHION outfit tile is bigger and easier to make out.
